Meta.homeTitle: Danxomè · Premium journeys through Benin, the Kingdom of Dahomey
Meta.homeDescription: Enter the kingdom. Small-group and private journeys through Benin's royal cities, living Vodun, stilt towns, savannah and coast. Also written Danxome.

Hero.statement: The modern way into Benin's kingdoms, lagoons, forests and coast.
Hero.mediaSlot: hero-loop.mp4 · 16:9 · ≤8s · ≤2 MB · poster hero-poster.jpg 2400×1350. Mobile shows the poster only.

Intro.statement: A kingdom did not end here. It went quiet, and it is still here.
Intro.body1: Benin is where the Kingdom of Dahomey rose, where Vodun was born and is still practised every day, where a whole town stands on stilts in a lagoon, and where the last great lions of West Africa hunt. Most people have never been. We take you in slowly, in comfort, with people who belong here.
Intro.body2: Small groups, never more than eight. Private guides from Ouidah, Abomey and the Atakora. Every journey is built around one story and told properly.

Season.title: October to March. Dry roads, clear skies, harmattan light.
Season.body: Journeys run through the dry season, when the lagoons are calm, the north is passable and the animals of Pendjari gather at the waterholes. January brings Vodun Days to Ouidah. We travel year round on the coast and in the south.

Founder.quote: I grew up being told our history was something to be quiet about. This company exists to tell it out loud, and to let you stand where it happened.
Founder.name: [Founder name]

Destinations.title: Seven places, one country
Destinations.note: Coordinates to the nearest minute, cross-checked against OpenStreetMap before launch.

Proverb.text: Slowly, slowly, the chameleon reaches the top of the tree.
Proverb.detail: Emblem of King Akaba of Dahomey

Route.title: To the edge of the savannah
Route.body: The road north leaves the lagoon, climbs through the Dahomey Gap and the Collines, and ends at the Atakora range. We break it in Abomey and Natitingou. There is no hurry; the road is the journey.
Route.mapSlot: Commissioned line-art map of Benin, SVG

Return.title: For those whose story passed through this gate.
Return.body: Ancestry-led itineraries from Ouidah's Route des Esclaves to the villages the records point to. Help with documents, DNA results, and the quiet logistics of coming back. Our signature journey, built with diaspora travellers.

Planning.title: Start planning your journey
Planning.body: Tell us when you can travel and what you are looking for. A real person replies within one working day, by email or WhatsApp.

1.title: Consultation
1.body: A call or WhatsApp conversation to understand what you want from Benin, your dates and your pace.

2.title: Confirmation
2.body: You confirm dates with a deposit, in FCFA by mobile money or in euros by card.

3.title: Planning
3.body: We build the day-by-day, book guides and rooms, and send a single itinerary document.

4.title: Documents
4.body: E-visa, health recommendations and insurance, with our checklist and reminders.

5.title: Arrival briefing
5.body: We meet you at Cotonou airport. A briefing on money, etiquette and Vodun protocol over your first meal.

6.title: Departure
6.body: Photos, a written account of your journey, and the door left open for the next one.
